name: assistant-app
behavior: Onboarding shows once, then sign in (Apple, Google or a 6-digit email code), then the tabs. Signing out returns to sign in. The session is saved on the device (AsyncStorage) and guarded with Expo Router’s Stack.Protected.
Fully controlled: your message goes in, the reply streams in word by word with a Stop button, and suggestion chips fill the empty state. The tab bar steps aside while the keyboard is up.
Every conversation, newest first. Tap to reopen it in Chat, swipe to delete, or compose a new one.
Pushed from Profile. Appearance (System / Light / Dark) re-themes every kit component instantly.
lib/assistant-app/assistant.ts streams a canned answer so the app runs with no backend. Replace `reply` with a call to your server, which calls the model API — never ship an API key in the app.
